english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken noun for a social friend, and it can also be used loosely for someone known through others.
This is the all-purpose noun for a friend or pal.
Use 朋友 as the all-purpose noun for a friend or casual acquaintance.
This is the all-purpose choice for an ordinary friend, including the pub-companion sense.
This is the everyday all-purpose word for a companion or comrade.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for a friend or buddy.
